title: TITAN-VIBE: Virtual Intact Block Extraction for periodic reconstruction
description: TITAN-VIBE 1.1.0: steric overlaps are reported as a property of the input instead of choosing a placement; contact networks that close through the periodic boundary are labelled extended_periodic, with the rank and generators of their cycle lattice; bonded windings are reported; the common-topology reader follows [ molecules ]; titan.exe -vibe-help. Includes a Windows x86-64 executable, the buildable TITAN host source with HoloLift omitted, quick-start examples with several snapshots, the 480 held-out inputs, and replay drivers with the validation records of this release.
